name: edf-replay
description: edf-replay (replayManager) — the single block<->graph boundary, both directions. -buildGraph computes a graph from a manifest by replaying its ordered blocks into a provisioned instance, stamping every node/edge with --owner; -extractSchema serializes exactly one PG-JSONL schemaBlock out of a live graph. Reads the manifest->blocks order via forge-store; holds no SQL and no credentials on the command line.
author: tqii
